description: Create a broadcast in draft state, targeting an audience. Does NOT send it — use send_broadcast to send or schedule after reviewing. Provide `html` or `templateId`. If `from` is omitted the configured default sender is used.

from.description: Sender. Defaults to the configured sender.

replyTo.description: Where replies go, e.g. "Support <support@acme.com>". Defaults to the configured reply-to.

templateId.description: A saved template to use as the body instead of `html`.

topicId.description: Narrows the audience to the contacts subscribed to this topic. Omit to send to the whole audience. Call list_topics first when the message is one kind of mail among several — sending a product announcement to everyone is what drives unsubscribes.

trackClicks.description: Rewrite links through the tracking host to count clicks. Defaults to the account setting. Mailbox providers penalise the link mismatch, so leave it off unless clicks are needed.

trackOpens.description: Count opens with a tracking pixel. Defaults to the account setting. Off is better for deliverability.

name: create_broadcast

heldReason.description: Why the broadcast is held for review, when it is.

stats.description: Recipient counts by delivery status. Present on get_broadcast.

status.description: draft, scheduled, sending, sent, paused, held or cancelled.

title: Create a broadcast (draft)
